bugs.criterion: Upcoming dues report unchanged after the speed fix
bugs.title: Reports → Upcoming dues always shows 0 rows although the API returns rows
bugs.evidence: Browser: Rows 0 / 'No data for these filters' (screenshot upcoming-dues-and-week-nav-failure.png). API: GET /api/reports/upcoming-dues -> 200 {items:[158 rows], total_paise:12119021200, horizon_days:30}. Cause: routers/construction.py returns the rows under 'items', but pages/Reports.jsx renders data.rows (e.g. line 337 'Rows' = d.rows?.length). Possible fixes: return 'rows', or map items to rows. Also add a days (30/90/365) filter to FILTERS['upcoming-dues'].

action_items.detail: The Home page has no upcoming-dues widget. /api/dashboard returns collections.upcoming_installments, but no frontend file renders it. Either build the widget or drop it from the criterion.
The 'Message templates' page h1 reads 'Demand raised', which is the first template name, not 'Message templates'. This is cosmetic.
